SELECT f.*, c.name AS contact_name, (SELECT MAX(a.create_time) FROM crm_activity a WHERE a.channel = 'wechat_mp' AND a.payload::jsonb ->> 'open_id' = f.open_id) AS last_activity_at FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan f LEFT JOIN crm_contact c ON c.contact_id = f.contact_id
AND f.app_id = #{appId} AND f.subscribe = #{subscribe} AND f.contact_id = #{contactId}
AND (f.nickname ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%') OR f.open_id ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND open_id = #{openId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND subscribe = true ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan WHERE union_id = #{unionId} AND union_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wechat_mp_fan ( app_id, open_id, union_id, nickname, avatar_url, subscribe, subscribe_time, unsubscribe_time, sex, country, province, city, remark, tag_ids, subscribe_scene, contact_id, last_sync_at, update_time ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{openId}, #{unionId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{subscribe}, #{subscribeTime}, #{unsubscribeTime}, #{sex}, #{country}, #{province}, #{city}, #{remark}, #{tagIds}::jsonb, #{subscribeScene}, #{contactId}, #{lastSyncAt}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (app_id, open_id) DO UPDATE SET union_id = EXCLUDED.union_id, nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname, avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url, subscribe = EXCLUDED.subscribe, subscribe_time = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.subscribe_time, crm_wechat_mp_fan.subscribe_time), unsubscribe_time = EXCLUDED.unsubscribe_time, sex = EXCLUDED.sex, country = EXCLUDED.country, province = EXCLUDED.province, city = EXCLUDED.city, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, tag_ids = EXCLUDED.tag_ids, subscribe_scene = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.subscribe_scene, crm_wechat_mp_fan.subscribe_scene), contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wechat_mp_fan.contact_id), last_sync_at = EXCLUDED.last_sync_at, update_time = now()
